units.zh: 姚文田，字秋農，浙江歸安人。
units.en: Yao Wentian, whose courtesy name was Qiunong, came from Gui'an in Zhejiang.
units.literal: Yao Wentian, courtesy name Qiunong, was a native of Gui'an in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 乾隆五十九年，高宗幸天津，召試第一，授內閣中書，充軍機章京。
units.en: In 1794, when the Qianlong Emperor traveled to Tianjin, Yao placed first in the summoned examination and was appointed an Inner Cabinet secretary, serving as a Grand Council clerk.
units.literal: In the fifty-ninth year of Qianlong, the Gaozong Emperor visited Tianjin; he ranked first in the summoned examination and was appointed Inner Cabinet Secretary, serving as a clerk of the Grand Council.

units.zh: 嘉慶四年一甲一名進士，授修撰。
units.en: In 1799 he took the jinshi degree as the top scholar in the first class and was appointed a Hanlin compiler.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he became a jinshi of the first rank in the first class and was appointed Hanlin Compiler.

units.zh: 迭典廣東、福建鄉試，督廣東、河南學政，累遷祭酒。
units.en: He successively served as chief examiner for the Guangdong and Fujian provincial examinations, held the post of education commissioner in Guangdong and Henan, and rose step by step to Chancellor of the Imperial Academy.
units.literal: In succession he presided over the provincial examinations of Guangdong and Fujian, supervised education as provincial education commissioner in Guangdong and Henan, and was promoted repeatedly until he became Chancellor of the Imperial Academy.

units.zh: 十八年，入直南書房。
units.en: In 1813 he was assigned to duty in the Southern Study.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year he entered service in the Southern Study.

units.zh: 會因林清之變，下詔求言，文田疏陳，略謂：「堯、舜、三代之治，不越教養兩端：為民正趨向之路，知有長上，自不干左道之誅；
units.en: After the Lin Qing rebellion, the throne called for memorials of counsel; Wentian submitted a memorial arguing, in essence: "The rule of Yao, Shun, and the Three Dynasties rested on only two pillars—moral instruction and material support: by guiding the people onto the proper path so they recognized authority above them, they would not stray into heterodox cults and invite punishment;
units.literal: When the Lin Qing incident occurred, an edict was issued soliciting advice; Wentian submitted a memorial stating, in summary: "The governance of Yao, Shun, and the Three Dynasties did not go beyond two principles—education and nurture: to set the people on the right path, so that knowing they had superiors, they would not run afoul of heterodox doctrines and face punishment;

units.zh: 為民廣衣食之源，各保身家，自不致有為惡之意。
units.en: by expanding the people's means of livelihood so that each household could secure its own welfare, they would not be driven to evil intent in the first place.
units.literal: to broaden the sources of food and clothing for the people, so that each might preserve household and person, and would not come to harbor intent to do evil.

units.zh: 近日南方患賦重，北方患徭多，民困官貧，急宜省事。
units.en: Lately the south has groaned under heavy taxes and the north under excessive corvée; with the people in distress and officials strapped, government business urgently needs to be streamlined.
units.literal: Recently the south has suffered from heavy taxation and the north from excessive corvée labor; the people are distressed and officials impoverished—affairs of state should urgently be simplified.

units.zh: 久督撫任期，則州縣供億少，寬​​州縣例議，則人才保全多。」
units.en: If governors-general and governors served longer terms, counties and districts would have to supply their establishments less; if the routine charges against county and district magistrates were relaxed, more talented men could be preserved in office."
units.literal: If governors-general and governors serve long terms, then the burden of supplying their establishments falls less on counties and districts; if regulations burdening counties and districts are relaxed, then more talented men can be preserved in office."

units.zh: 次年復上疏，言：「上之於下，不患其不畏，而患其不愛。
units.en: The next year he memorialized again: "A ruler need not worry that his subjects lack fear; he should worry that they lack affection.
units.literal: The following year he submitted another memorial, saying: "Between superior and subordinate, the concern is not that they do not fear, but that they do not love.

units.zh: 漢文吏治蒸蒸，不至於姦，愛故也。
units.en: Under Emperor Wen of Han the civil service thrived without sinking into corruption—because the people were governed with affection.
units.literal: Under Emperor Wen of Han the administration flourished and did not descend into wickedness—because of love.

units.zh: 秦顓法律，衡石程書，一夫夜呼，亂者四起，畏故也。
units.en: The Qin ruled through draconian law, weighing documents by the stone and assigning them by quota; when one man shouted in the night, rebellion broke out everywhere—because the people were governed through fear alone.
units.literal: The Qin relied on harsh laws, weighing documents by the stone and scheduling them by the bushel; one man cried out in the night and rebels rose on every side—because of fear.

units.zh: 自數年來，開上控之端，刁民得逞其奸；
units.en: In recent years the practice of appealing cases to the capital has opened the way for scheming litigants to have their way;
units.literal: In recent years the door to appeals to the capital has been opened, and crafty commoners have been able to carry out their schemes;

units.zh: 大吏畏其京控，遇案親提，訐訴不過一人，牽涉常至數十，農商廢業，中道奔波，受胥吏折辱，甚至瘐死道斃。
units.en: senior officials, dreading capital appeals, personally take charge of cases; though the plaintiff is a single individual, dozens are often dragged in; farmers and merchants abandon their livelihoods, travel halfway across the country, endure abuse from clerks and runners, and some even die of exhaustion along the road.
units.literal: high officials, fearing appeals to the capital, personally take up cases when they arise; though the accuser is but one person, those implicated often number dozens; farmers and merchants abandon their trades, rush about on the road midway, suffer humiliation at the hands of clerks and runners, and some even die of exhaustion on the road.

units.zh: 國家慎刑之意，亦曰有冤抑耳。
units.en: The state's purpose in exercising caution with punishments is precisely to redress wrongful oppression.
units.literal: The state's intent in being cautious with punishments is likewise said to be that there may be wrongful oppression.

units.zh: 從前馬譚氏一案，至今未有正兇，無辜致斃者累累。
units.en: In the old Ma–Tan clan case, the real culprit has still not been identified, while innocent people were put to death in great numbers.
units.literal: In the former case of the Ma and Tan clans, to this day the true culprit has not been found, and the innocents who were put to death are numerous.

units.zh: 是一冤未雪，而含冤者且數十人。
units.en: One wrong goes unavenged while dozens more bear injustice.
units.literal: Thus one injustice goes unredressed while those who suffer injustice number dozens.

units.zh: 承審官刑撻橫加，以期得實，其中冤抑，正復不少。
units.en: Trial officers beat and flog defendants freely in hopes of extracting confessions, and wrongful convictions are far from uncommon.
units.literal: The examining officials apply beating and flogging indiscriminately in hopes of obtaining the truth; among them wrongful oppression is by no means rare.

units.zh: 欲召天和，其可得乎？
units.en: How can one hope to summon heavenly harmony under such conditions?
units.literal: If one wishes to summon heavenly harmony, how can it be attained?

units.zh: 頃者林清構逆，搜捕四出，至今未已。
units.en: When Lin Qing recently rebelled, searches and arrests were launched everywhere and have not yet ended.
units.literal: Recently Lin Qing raised rebellion; searches and arrests have been sent out on all sides and have not ceased to this day.

units.zh: 小人意圖見長，不能無殃及無辜，奉旨嚴禁，仰見皇上如天之仁。
units.en: Petty schemers, emboldened by success, inevitably drag in the innocent as well; the recent strict prohibition shows the Emperor's heaven-like mercy.
units.literal: Petty men, seeing their schemes succeed, cannot but involve the innocent as well; an edict has strictly forbidden this, and one looks up to perceive the Emperor's heaven-like benevolence.

units.zh: 臣以為事愈多則擾愈眾，莠民易逞機謀，良善惟增苦累。
units.en: I believe that the more cases multiply, the wider the disruption spreads; scoundrels find it easy to plot, while the law-abiding gain only added misery.
units.literal: Your subject believes that the more affairs there are, the more numerous the disturbances; wicked commoners easily carry out their schemes, while the good suffer only added hardship.

units.zh: 應令大小官吏，可結速結，無多株引，庶上下相愛，暴亂不作矣。
units.en: Officials at every level should be required to close cases promptly when they can, without dragging in unrelated parties, so that rulers and ruled may live in mutual regard and violent disorder may be prevented.
units.literal: Officials great and small should be ordered to conclude cases that can be concluded quickly, without implicating many others, so that superiors and subordinates may love one another and violent disorder not arise.

units.zh: 至所謂養民之政，不外於農桑本務。
units.en: As for policies that truly nurture the people, they come down to nothing more than the fundamental work of farming and sericulture.
units.literal: As for what is called the policy of nurturing the people, it does not go beyond the fundamental tasks of farming and sericulture.

units.zh: 大江以南，地不如中原之廣，每歲漕儲正供，為京畿所仰給者，無他，人力盡也。
units.en: South of the Yangzi the land is narrower than the Central Plain, yet each year the canal grain that feeds the capital comes from there alone—the people have given all their strength.
units.literal: South of the Great River the land is not as broad as the Central Plain; each year the regular grain tribute transported by canal, on which the capital region relies for supply, has no other source—the people's labor is exhausted.

units.zh: 兗州以北，古稱沃衍；
units.en: North of Yanzhou was once renowned as rich and fertile;
units.literal: North of Yanzhou was anciently called fertile and expansive;

units.zh: 河南一省，皆殷、週畿內；
units.en: the whole of Henan lay within the heartlands of the Yin and Zhou;
units.literal: the whole province of Henan lay within the inner domains of Yin and Zhou;

units.zh: 燕、趙之間，亦夙稱富國。
units.en: and the lands between Yan and Zhao were long famed as prosperous states.
units.literal: the region between Yan and Zhao was also long called a wealthy country.

units.zh: 今則地成曠土，人盡惰民，安得不窮困而為盜賊？
units.en: Today those fields lie fallow and the people have grown idle—how can they escape poverty and turn to banditry?
units.literal: Now the land has become wasteland and the people are all indolent commoners—how can they not fall into destitution and become bandits?

units.zh: 歲一歉收，先請緩徵，稍甚則加蠲貸，又其甚則截漕發粟以賑之，所以耗國帑者何可算也。
units.en: After a poor harvest, tax collection is first deferred; if conditions worsen, remissions and loans follow; in the worst cases canal grain is diverted for relief—the drain on the treasury is incalculable.
units.literal: In a year of poor harvest, deferment of collection is first requested; if somewhat worse, remission and loans are added; if still worse, canal grain is diverted and grain issued for relief—the drain on the national treasury is beyond calculation.

units.zh: 運河屢淤，東南漕未可恃，設有意外，何以處此？
units.en: The Grand Canal silts up again and again, and southeastern grain transport cannot be relied on—if disaster strikes, how will the capital be fed?
units.literal: The Grand Canal is repeatedly silted up; southeastern canal transport cannot be relied upon—if some unforeseen event occurs, how is this to be dealt with?

units.zh: 臣見歷來保薦州縣，必首列勸課農桑，其實盡屬虛談，從無過問。
units.en: In every recommendation of local magistrates, promoting farming and sericulture heads the list, yet in practice this is mere rhetoric and no one ever checks.
units.literal: Your subject has seen that in recommendations of county and district magistrates, exhortation to promote farming and sericulture is always listed first, yet in reality it is all empty talk and never followed up.

units.zh: 大吏奏報糧價，有市價至四五千錢，僅報二兩內外，其於收成，又虛加分數，相習成風。
units.en: Senior officials reporting grain prices will cite market rates of four or five thousand cash per unit while reporting only about two taels, and routinely inflate harvest figures—a practice now habitual throughout the bureaucracy.
units.literal: When great officials report grain prices, though market prices reach four or five thousand cash, they report only about two taels; as for harvest yields, they also inflate the figures—a practice that has become habitual.

units.zh: 但使董勸有方，行之一方而收利，自然爭起相效，田野皆闢，水旱有資，豈必盡資官帑，善政乃行哉？
units.en: With sound supervision and encouragement, once one region prospered others would naturally follow; wasteland would be reclaimed and reserves built against flood and drought—good government need not depend entirely on the treasury.
units.literal: If only supervision and encouragement were well directed, and implemented in one region with profit gained, naturally all would vie to follow; fields would all be opened, and there would be resources against flood and drought—must one rely entirely on the official treasury for good government to be carried out?

units.zh: 民之犯刑，由於不率教；
units.en: People break the law because they have not been properly instructed;
units.literal: The people's violation of the penal code stems from not following instruction;

units.zh: 其不率教，由於衣食缺乏而廉恥不興。
units.en: and they fail to follow instruction because they lack food and clothing and therefore lack the sense of honor and shame that instruction requires.
units.literal: their failure to follow instruction stems from lack of food and clothing and the failure of probity and shame to arise.

units.zh: 其次第如此，故養民為首務也。」
units.en: This is the chain of causation; nurturing the people must therefore come first."
units.literal: The sequence of causes is thus; therefore nurturing the people is the foremost task."

units.zh: 奏入，仁宗嘉納之，特詔飭各省以勸課農桑為亟，速清訟獄，嚴懲誣枉。
units.en: The memorial was well received by Emperor Renzong, who issued a special edict ordering every province to prioritize agricultural promotion, clear court backlogs swiftly, and punish false accusations severely.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted, Emperor Renzong praised and accepted it, issuing a special edict ordering each province to make exhortation to farming and sericulture urgent, to clear lawsuits and prisons quickly, and to punish severely false accusations.

units.zh: 二十年，擢兵部侍郎，歷戶部、禮部。
units.en: In 1815 he was promoted to Vice Minister of War and later served in the Ministries of Revenue and Rites.
units.literal: In the twentieth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of War and served successively in the Ministries of Revenue and Rites.

units.zh: 二十二年，典會試。
units.en: In 1817 he served as chief examiner for the metropolitan civil service examination.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year he presided over the metropolitan examination.

units.zh: 二十四年，督江蘇學政。
units.en: In 1819 he was appointed education commissioner for Jiangsu.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he supervised education in Jiangsu.

units.zh: 道光元年，江、浙督撫孫玉庭等議禁漕務浮收，明定八折，實許其加二。
units.en: In 1821 the Jiangsu and Zhejiang governors-general and governors, including Sun Yuting, proposed banning illicit surcharges on grain transport, formally capping collection at eighty percent while tacitly allowing an extra twenty percent.
units.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, the governors-general and governors of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, Sun Yuting and others, proposed prohibiting illicit surcharges in grain transport affairs, explicitly fixing an eight-tenths rate while in fact permitting an additional two-tenths.

units.zh: 文田疏陳積弊曰：「乾隆三十年以前，並無所謂浮收。
units.en: Wentian memorialized on longstanding abuses: "Before 1765 there was no such practice as illicit surcharge.
units.literal: Wentian submitted a memorial detailing accumulated abuses, saying: "Before the thirtieth year of Qianlong there was no such thing as illicit surcharge.

units.zh: 厥後生齒日繁，物價踴貴，官民交困，然猶止就斛面浮取而已。
units.en: Thereafter population grew and prices rose; officials and commoners alike were squeezed, yet surcharges were still limited to skimming the top of the grain measure.
units.literal: Afterward population grew daily and prices soared; officials and people alike were distressed, yet surcharges were still taken only on the surface of the grain measure.

units.zh: 未幾而有折扣之舉，始每石不過折耗數升，繼乃至五折、六折不等。
units.en: Soon discounting was introduced: at first only a few sheng per shi were deducted for wastage, but eventually deductions reached fifty or sixty percent.
units.literal: Before long there came the practice of discounting: at first no more than a few sheng per shi were deducted for wastage, but later this reached five-tenths, six-tenths, and so on.

units.zh: 小民終歲勤動，事畜不贍，勢必與官抗。
units.en: Commoners toil all year yet cannot support their families—they are bound to resist official exactions.
units.literal: The common people toil through the year yet cannot support their households and livestock—they are bound to resist the officials.

units.zh: 官即從而製之，所舉以為民罪者三：曰抗糧，曰包完，曰挜交醜米。
units.en: Officials then devised means to control them, charging three offenses: resisting tax payment, having others pay on one's behalf, and substituting inferior grain.
units.literal: The officials then contrived to control them, citing three crimes of the people: resisting grain payment, having others pay on one's behalf, and substituting inferior grain.

units.zh: 民間零星小戶、貧苦之家，拖欠勢所必有。
units.en: Small scattered households and poor families inevitably fall behind on payments.
units.literal: Among the people, scattered small households and poor families inevitably fall into arrears.

units.zh: 若家有數十百畝之產，竟置官賦於不問，實事所絕無。
units.en: Households with tens or hundreds of mu of land simply ignoring their tax obligations—such cases truly do not exist.
units.literal: If a household possesses several tens or hundreds of mu of property yet entirely ignores official levies, such a thing is in truth utterly unknown.

units.zh: 今之所謂抗糧者，如業戶應完若干石，多齎一二成以備折收，書吏等先以淋尖、踢腳、灑散多方糜耗，是已不敷；
units.en: What is now called tax resistance works like this: a landholder owes a set number of shi and brings an extra ten or twenty percent to cover expected deductions; clerks first waste grain through heaping, kicking, and scattering techniques—leaving the delivery short before discounts are even applied;
units.literal: What is now called resisting grain payment is like this: a landholding household should deliver a certain number of shi and brings an extra ten or twenty percent to cover discounting; clerks first waste much through heaping, kicking, and scattering—so it is already insufficient;

units.zh: 再以折扣計算，如準作七折，便須再加三四成，業戶必至爭執。
units.en: then discounting is applied again—if grain is assessed at seventy percent, another thirty or forty percent must be added, and the landholder inevitably protests.
units.literal: then discounting is calculated again—if assessed at seven-tenths, another three or four tenths must be added, and the landholder is bound to dispute.

units.zh: 間有原米運回，州縣即指為抗欠，此其由也。
units.en: Sometimes the original grain is sent back, and the magistrate immediately labels it tax resistance—this is how such charges arise.
units.literal: Occasionally the original grain is sent back, and the county or district magistrate immediately labels it resistance to payment—this is the reason.

units.zh: 包完者，寡弱之戶，轉交有力者代為輸納。
units.en: Having others pay on one's behalf means weak households entrust payment to powerful intermediaries.
units.literal: Having others pay on one's behalf means weak and isolated households turn delivery over to powerful persons to pay for them.

units.zh: 然官吏果甚公正，何庸託人？
units.en: Yet if officials were truly fair, why would anyone need an intermediary?
units.literal: Yet if officials were truly very fair, why would one need to entrust others?

units.zh: 可不煩言而自破。
units.en: This charge collapses under scrutiny without further argument.
units.literal: This charge collapses of itself without need for lengthy argument.

units.zh: 民間運米進倉，男婦老幼進城守待，陰雨濕露，猶百計保護，恐米色變傷。
units.en: When commoners deliver grain to the granary, entire families wait in the city; even in rain and damp they protect their grain carefully, fearing spoilage.
units.literal: When the people transport grain into the granary, men, women, old, and young enter the city to wait; in rain and damp they still do all they can to protect it, fearing the grain color will change and spoil.

units.zh: 謂其特以醜米挜交，殆非人情。
units.en: To claim they deliberately substitute inferior grain strains credulity.
units.literal: To say they deliberately substitute inferior grain is hardly in accord with human nature.

units.zh: 惟年歲不齊，米色不能畫一，亦間有之。
units.en: Only in years of uneven harvest, when grain quality naturally varies, does this occasionally happen.
units.literal: Only when harvest years are uneven and grain color cannot be uniform does this occasionally occur.

units.zh: 然官吏非執此三者，不能相制，生監暫革，齊民拘禁，俟其補交，然後請釋。
units.en: Yet officials cannot control taxpayers without these three charges: degree-holders are temporarily stripped of status, commoners are detained, and released only after back payment.
units.literal: Yet officials cannot control the people without wielding these three charges: licentiates and Imperial Academy students are temporarily stripped of status, ordinary commoners are detained, and release is requested only after they make up payment.

units.zh: 不知此皆良民，非莠民也。
units.en: They fail to see that these are law-abiding people, not criminals.
units.literal: They do not know that these are all good commoners, not wicked ones.

units.zh: 此小民不能上達之實情也。
units.en: This is the reality commoners cannot convey to the throne.
units.literal: This is the true situation of the common people that cannot reach the throne.

units.zh: 然州縣亦有不能不爾者，自開倉訖兌運，修整倉廒蘆席、竹木、繩索、油燭百需，幕丁胥役脩飯工食，加以運丁需索津貼滋甚，至其平日廉俸公項不能敷用。
units.en: Yet magistrates also have reasons they cannot act otherwise: from opening granaries through delivery, repairs, supplies, clerks' meals, and ever-growing demands from transport workers for subsidies—even their official salaries and public funds fall short.
units.literal: Yet county and district magistrates also have reasons they cannot do otherwise: from opening the granary until delivery for transport, repairing granaries, reed mats, bamboo, wood, rope, lamp oil, and a hundred other needs, meals for secretaries, runners, and clerks, plus transport workers' demands for subsidies growing ever greater—even their usual honest salaries and public funds cannot cover expenses.

units.zh: 無論大小公事，一到即須出錢料理。
units.en: Every matter of public business, large or small, requires immediate out-of-pocket spending.
units.literal: Whether great or small public business, as soon as it arrives money must be spent to handle it.

units.zh: 即如辦一徒罪之犯，自初詳至結案，約須百數十金。
units.en: Even processing a single penal-servitude case from initial report to closure costs well over a hundred taels.
units.literal: Even handling one offender guilty of penal servitude, from initial report to case closure, requires roughly one hundred and several tens in cash.

units.zh: 案愈巨則費愈多。
units.en: The larger the case, the higher the cost.
units.literal: The greater the case, the greater the expense.

units.zh: 遞解人犯，運送糧鞘，事事皆需費用。
units.en: Escorting prisoners, transporting grain convoys—everything requires money.
units.literal: Escorting prisoners, transporting grain convoys—every matter requires expense.

units.zh: 若不取之於民，謹厚者奉身而退，貪婪者非向詞訟生髮不可，吏治更不可問。
units.en: Without extracting money from the people, honest officials resign while greedy ones must profit from litigation—local governance becomes impossible.
units.literal: If not taken from the people, the scrupulous resign and withdraw, while the greedy have no choice but to profit from lawsuits—local administration becomes still more hopeless.

units.zh: 彼思他弊獲咎愈重，不若浮收為上下咸知，故甘受民怨而不惜。
units.en: They reason that other abuses bring harsher punishment, while surcharges are an open secret at every level, so they willingly endure popular resentment.
units.literal: They consider that other abuses bring heavier blame, whereas illicit surcharge is known to all above and below, so they willingly endure popular resentment without regret.

units.zh: 其藉以自肥者固多，而迫於不獲已者蓋亦不少。
units.en: Many do enrich themselves this way, but many others are driven to it by sheer necessity.
units.literal: Those who use this to enrich themselves are indeed many, yet those compelled by necessity are also not few.

units.zh: 言事者動稱'不肖州縣'，州縣亦人耳，何至一行作吏，便行同苟賤？
units.en: Memorialists constantly denounce 'unworthy magistrates'—but magistrates are human beings; how could they all become base and corrupt the moment they take office?
units.literal: Memorialists constantly call them 'unworthy county and district magistrates'—but magistrates are also human; how is it that upon taking office as officials they all become alike in baseness and vileness?

units.zh: 此又州縣不能上達之實情也。
units.en: This, too, is the reality magistrates cannot convey to the throne.
units.literal: This is again the true situation of county and district magistrates that cannot reach the throne.

units.zh: 州縣受掊克之名，而運丁陰受其益，然亦有不能不然者。
units.en: Magistrates bear the blame for extortion while transport workers secretly profit—yet they, too, have reasons they cannot act otherwise.
units.literal: County and district magistrates bear the name of extortion while transport workers secretly benefit—yet there are also reasons they cannot do otherwise.

units.zh: 昔時運道深通，運丁或藉來往攜貨售賣以贍用；
units.en: Formerly the canal ran deep and transport workers could carry goods on return trips to support themselves;
units.literal: Formerly the transport route was deeply navigable, and transport workers could rely on carrying goods back and forth for sale to support themselves;

units.zh: 後因黃河屢經倒灌，運道受害，慮其船重難行，嚴禁多帶貨物。
units.en: later repeated Yellow River flooding damaged the route; fearing overloaded boats, officials strictly limited cargo.
units.literal: later because the Yellow River repeatedly backed up and flooded, the transport route suffered damage; fearing boats would be too heavy to travel, carrying much cargo was strictly forbidden.

units.zh: 又從前回空帶鹽，不甚搜查；
units.en: Formerly on empty return voyages they carried salt with little interference;
units.literal: Moreover, formerly on empty return trips they carried salt and were not much searched;

units.zh: 近因鹽商力絀，未免算及瑣屑，而各丁出息遂盡。
units.en: recently, with salt merchants under pressure, even minor infractions were pursued, exhausting workers' supplementary income.
units.literal: recently because salt merchants were strained, trifling matters were inevitably reckoned against them, and each worker's income was thus exhausted.

units.zh: 加以運道日淺，反多添夫撥淺之費。
units.en: As the canal grows shallower, extra costs for hiring laborers to pole through shallows have mounted.
units.literal: Added to this, as the transport route grows shallower daily, there are instead more expenses for hiring laborers to pole through shallows.

units.zh: 此費不出之州縣，更無所出。
units.en: If counties and districts do not pay these costs, there is nowhere else the money can come from.
units.literal: If this expense does not come from the counties and districts, there is nowhere else it can come from.

units.zh: 此又運丁不能上達之實情也。
units.en: This, too, is the reality transport workers cannot convey to the throne.
units.literal: This is again the true situation of transport workers that cannot reach the throne.

units.zh: 數年前因津貼日增，於是定例只准給三百兩。
units.en: Several years ago, as subsidies mounted, regulations capped payments at three hundred taels.
units.literal: Several years ago because subsidies grew daily, a regulation was fixed allowing only three hundred taels.

units.zh: 運丁實不濟用，則重船不能開，州縣必獲咎戾，不免私自增給，是所謂三百兩者虛名耳。
units.en: Three hundred taels is insufficient; heavy boats cannot sail and magistrates face blame, so they privately add more—the regulated amount is merely nominal.
units.literal: Transport workers in truth cannot make ends meet; then heavy boats cannot depart and counties and districts are sure to incur blame, so they cannot but privately add more—the so-called three hundred taels is but an empty name.

units.zh: 頃又以浮收過甚，嚴禁收漕不得過八折。
units.en: Recently, because surcharges had grown excessive, collection was strictly capped at eighty percent.
units.literal: Recently because illicit surcharges were excessive, it was strictly forbidden to collect grain transport tax at more than eight-tenths.

units.zh: 州縣入不敷出，則強者不敢與較，弱者仍肆朘削，是所謂八折者亦虛名耳。
units.en: With magistrates' income falling short, the powerful dare not protest while the weak are still exploited—the eighty-percent cap is also merely nominal.
units.literal: When counties and districts have income insufficient for expenditure, the strong dare not dispute while the weak are still wantonly exploited—the so-called eight-tenths is also but an empty name.

units.zh: 然民間執詞抗官，官必設法箝制，而事端因以滋生，皆出於民心之不服。
units.en: When commoners resist with legal arguments, officials devise means to suppress them, breeding further incidents—all stemming from popular discontent.
units.literal: Yet when the people cling to arguments to resist officials, officials must devise means to restrain them, and incidents thus arise—all stemming from popular hearts' discontent.

units.zh: 若將此不靖之民盡法懲處，則既困浮收，复陷法網，民心恐愈不平。
units.en: If all such restless commoners are punished to the full extent of the law, they will be squeezed by surcharges and trapped in the legal net—popular resentment will only deepen.
units.literal: If these unruly commoners are all punished to the full extent of the law, they are already distressed by illicit surcharge and again fall into the legal net—popular hearts will likely grow still more discontent.

units.zh: 若一味姑容隱忍，則小民開犯上之風，將致不必收漕，而亦目無官長。
units.en: If officials indulge them endlessly, commoners will learn defiance, until grain transport is refused altogether and magistrates are held in contempt.
units.literal: If one indulges and tolerates without end, the common people will open a trend of defying superiors, leading to a state where grain transport need not be collected yet officials are also held in contempt.

units.zh: 其於紀綱法度，所關實為匪細。」
units.en: The stakes for law and order are by no means small."
units.literal: As for discipline and law, what is involved is truly no small matter."

units.zh: 疏入，下部議。
units.en: The memorial was referred to the relevant ministries for deliberation.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted, it was sent down to the ministries for deliberation.

units.zh: 時在廷諸臣多以為言，文田持議切中時弊，最得其平。
units.en: Many court ministers had already spoken on the matter; Wentian's analysis struck at the heart of contemporary abuses and was judged the most balanced.
units.literal: At the time many court ministers had spoken on the matter; Wentian's position struck at the abuses of the age and was most even-handed.

units.zh: 詔禁浮收，裁革運丁陋規，八折之議遂寢。
units.en: An edict banned illicit surcharges and abolished transport workers' improper practices; the eighty-percent proposal was shelved.
units.literal: An edict forbade illicit surcharges and cut away the transport workers' improper practices; the eight-tenths proposal was then shelved.

units.zh: 四年，擢左都御史。
units.en: In 1824 he was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 七年，遷禮部尚書。
units.en: In 1827 he was appointed Minister of Rites.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Minister of Rites.

units.zh: 尋卒，依尚書例賜卹，諡文僖。
units.en: He died soon after; funeral honors were granted according to ministerial precedent, and he was posthumously titled Wenxi.
units.literal: Soon afterward he died; according to the precedent for ministers, funeral favors were granted and he was given the posthumous title Wenxi.

units.zh: 文田持己方嚴，數督學政，革除陋例，斥偽體，拔真才，典試號得士。
units.en: Wentian was known for strict personal integrity; as education commissioner he abolished corrupt practices, rejected spurious examination styles, and selected genuine talent—his examinations were famed for producing worthy scholars.
units.literal: Wentian held himself with strict integrity; he several times supervised education, abolished improper practices, rejected spurious literary styles, selected true talent, and when presiding over examinations was famed for obtaining worthy men.

units.zh: 論學尊宋儒，所著書則宗漢學。
units.en: In his teaching he honored Song Neo-Confucianism, yet his scholarly writings followed the Han Learning tradition.
units.literal: In discussing learning he honored Song Neo-Confucians, yet in his writings he followed Han Learning.

units.zh: 博綜群籍，兼諳天文佔驗。
units.en: He mastered a wide range of texts and was also versed in astronomy and astrological divination.
units.literal: He broadly mastered many texts and was also versed in astronomy and divination.

units.zh: 林清之變未起，彗入紫微垣；
units.en: Before the Lin Qing rebellion, a comet entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure;
units.literal: Before the Lin Qing incident arose, a comet entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure;

units.zh: 道光初，彗見南斗下，主外夷兵事：文田皆先事言之。
units.en: at the start of the Daoguang reign a comet appeared below the Southern Dipper, portending war with foreigners—Wentian had predicted each of these events in advance.
units.literal: at the beginning of Daoguang a comet appeared below the Southern Dipper, presaging military affairs with foreign barbarians—Wentian had spoken of all these beforehand.

units.zh: 戴敦元，字金溪，浙江開化人。
units.en: Dai Dunyuan, whose courtesy name was Jinxi, came from Kaihua in Zhejiang.
units.literal: Dai Dunyuan, courtesy name Jinxi, was a native of Kaihua in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 幼有異禀，過外家，一月盡讀其室中書。
units.en: As a child he showed unusual gifts; visiting his maternal relatives, he read every book in their house within a month.
units.literal: As a child he had an unusual gift; visiting his maternal relatives' home, in one month he read all the books in their room.

units.zh: 十歲舉神童，學政彭元瑞試以文，如老宿；
units.en: At ten he was nominated as a child prodigy; when Education Commissioner Peng Yuanrui tested his essay, it read like the work of a seasoned scholar;
units.literal: At age ten he was nominated as a child prodigy; Education Commissioner Peng Yuanrui tested him with an essay, and it was like that of a seasoned scholar;

units.zh: 面問經義，答如流。
units.en: when questioned orally on classical interpretation, he answered without hesitation.
units.literal: when questioned face to face on the meaning of the classics, he answered fluently.

units.zh: 歎曰：「子異日必為國器！」
units.en: He exclaimed, "You will surely become a pillar of the state one day!"
units.literal: He sighed and said: "You will surely become a pillar of the state in days to come!"

units.zh: 年十五，舉鄉試。
units.en: At fifteen he passed the provincial examination.
units.literal: At age fifteen he passed the provincial examination.

units.zh: 乾隆五十五年，成進士，選庶吉士，散館改禮部主事，銓授刑部主事，典山西鄉試。
units.en: In 1790 he took the jinshi degree, entered the Hanlin Academy, and after completing his training served as a principal clerk in the Ministries of Rites and Punishments in turn, and presided over the Shanxi provincial examination.
units.literal: In the fifty-fifth year of Qianlong he became a jinshi, was selected as a Hanlin Bachelor, and after leaving the Hanlin Academy was transferred to a principal clerk in the Ministry of Rites, then appointed by selection as principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments, and presided over the Shanxi provincial examination.

units.zh: 累遷郎中。
units.en: He rose step by step to the rank of director.
units.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Director.

units.zh: 嘉慶二十四年，出為廣東高廉道。
units.en: In 1819 he was posted as Intendant of the Gaolian Circuit in Guangdong.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Jiaqing he went out to serve as Intendant of Gaolian Circuit in Guangdong.

units.zh: 道光元年，擢江西按察使。
units.en: In 1821 he was promoted to Provincial Judicial Commissioner of Jiangxi.
units.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he was promoted to Provincial Judicial Commissioner of Jiangxi.

units.zh: 敦元初外任，以情形非素習，蘇州多粵商，過訪風土利弊，久之始去，盡得要領。
units.en: On his first provincial posting, unfamiliar with local conditions, he stopped in Suzhou—home to many Cantonese merchants—to study regional customs and administrative problems at length before departing, having mastered the essentials.
units.literal: When Dunyuan first took an outside post, because conditions were not what he was accustomed to and Suzhou had many Cantonese merchants, he stopped to inquire about local customs and advantages and disadvantages, and only after a long while departed, having fully grasped the essentials.

units.zh: 至江西，無幕客，延屬吏諳刑名者以助，數月清積牘四千餘事。
units.en: In Jiangxi he employed no private secretaries but enlisted subordinates skilled in penal law; within months he cleared more than four thousand backlogged cases.
units.literal: Upon reaching Jiangxi, he had no private secretaries and engaged subordinate officials versed in penal matters to assist; in several months he cleared more than four thousand accumulated cases.

units.zh: 二年，遷山西布政使，單車之任，輿夫館人莫知為達官。
units.en: In 1822 he was transferred to Provincial Administration Commissioner of Shanxi, traveling alone to his post so that carriers and innkeepers never guessed he was a high official.
units.literal: In the second year he was transferred to Provincial Administration Commissioner of Shanxi; traveling alone to his post, cart drivers and innkeepers did not know he was a high official.

units.zh: 籓署有陋規曰釐頭銀，上下取給，敦元革之，曰：「官有養廉，僕禦官所豢，何贏餘之有？」
units.en: The provincial office had a corrupt practice called 'fraction-head silver' skimmed at every level; Dunyuan abolished it, saying, "Officials receive integrity allowances; servants are maintained by their masters—what surplus could there be?"
units.literal: The provincial administration office had an improper practice called 'fraction-head silver,' taken by superiors and subordinates alike for support; Dunyuan abolished it, saying: "Officials have integrity-nurturing allowances; servants are kept by officials—what surplus profit could there be?"

units.zh: 調湖南，護理巡撫。
units.en: He was transferred to Hunan and served as acting governor.
units.literal: He was transferred to Hunan and acted as Governor.

units.zh: 三年，召授刑部侍郎，自此歷十年，未遷他部，專治刑獄，剖析律意，於條例有罅漏，及因時制宜者，數奏請更定。
units.en: In 1823 he was recalled and appointed Vice Minister of Punishments; for the next ten years he remained in that ministry, specializing in penal law, analyzing statutory intent, and repeatedly memorializing to revise regulations where gaps existed or circumstances required adaptation.
units.literal: In the third year he was summoned and appointed Vice Minister of Punishments; from then for ten years he was not transferred to another ministry, specializing in penal affairs, analyzing the intent of statutes, and where regulations had gaps or required adaptation to the times, repeatedly memorializing to request revision.

units.zh: 每日部事畢，歸坐一室，謝絕賓客。
units.en: Each day after ministry business he retired to a single room and refused visitors.
units.literal: Each day when ministry business was finished, he returned to sit alone in one room and declined visitors.

units.zh: 十二年，擢刑部尚書，典會試。
units.en: In 1832 he was promoted to Minister of Punishments and served as chief examiner for the metropolitan examination.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Minister of Punishments and presided over the metropolitan examination.

units.zh: 十四年，卒，優詔賜卹，稱其清介自持，克盡職守，贈太子太保，諡簡恪。
units.en: He died in 1834; the throne granted funeral honors, praising his integrity and dedication; he was posthumously titled Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Jianke.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he died; a favorable edict granted funeral favors, praising his integrity and self-restraint and full discharge of duty; he was posthumously given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the title Jianke.

units.zh: 敦元博聞強識，目近視，觀書與面相磨，過輒不忘。
units.en: Dunyuan was prodigiously learned with an extraordinary memory; nearsighted, he read with his face nearly touching the page and never forgot what he had read.
units.literal: Dunyuan was broadly learned with a powerful memory; his eyes were nearsighted, and he read with his face nearly touching the book—once past, he never forgot.

units.zh: 每至一官，積牘覽一過，他日吏偶誤，輒摘正之，無敢欺者。
units.en: At every post he read through the backlog once; if a clerk erred later, he corrected it immediately—no one dared deceive him.
units.literal: Whenever he arrived at a post, he read through accumulated documents once; later if a clerk erred even slightly, he would immediately point out and correct it—none dared deceive him.

units.zh: 奏對有所諮詢，援引律例，誦故牘一字無舛誤，宣宗深重之。
units.en: When questioned in audience, he cited statutes and recited archival documents without a single error—the Daoguang Emperor valued him highly.
units.literal: When questioned in audience memorials, he cited statutes and regulations and recited old documents without a single character's error—the Xuanzong Emperor valued him deeply.

units.zh: 至老，或問僻事；
units.en: In old age, when asked obscure questions;
units.literal: In old age, if asked about obscure matters;

units.zh: 指某書某卷，百不一爽。
units.en: he would cite the exact book and volume without ever being wrong.
units.literal: he would point to such-and-such book and volume, never once mistaken.

units.zh: 嘗曰：「書籍浩如煙海，人生豈能盡閱？
units.en: He once remarked, "Books are vast as the sea—how can one person read them all in a lifetime?
units.literal: He once said: "Books are vast as a smoke-filled sea—how can one person in a lifetime read them all?

units.zh: 天下惟此義理，古今人所談，往往雷同。
units.en: Under heaven there is only this body of principle; what thinkers ancient and modern discuss is often the same.
units.literal: Under heaven there is only this principle; what people ancient and modern discuss is often the same.

units.zh: 當世以為獨得者，大抵昔人唾餘。」
units.en: What the present age treats as original insight is mostly what earlier thinkers had already discarded."
units.literal: What the present age considers uniquely obtained is mostly what men of old spat out as leftovers."

units.zh: 罕自為文，僅傳詩數卷。
units.en: He wrote little himself; only a few volumes of poetry survive.
units.literal: He rarely wrote on his own; only a few volumes of poetry survive.

units.zh: 喜天文、律算，討論有年，亦未自立一說。
units.en: He delighted in astronomy and mathematics and discussed them for years, yet never developed a theory of his own.
units.literal: He delighted in astronomy and mathematical harmonics, discussed them for years, yet never established a theory of his own.

units.zh: 卒之日，笥無餘衣，囷無餘粟，庀其貲不​​及百金，廉潔蓋性成雲。
units.en: At his death his chest held no spare clothes and his granary no spare grain; his estate amounted to less than one hundred taels—integrity and frugality were evidently inborn.
units.literal: On the day of his death his chest held no spare clothes, his granary no spare grain; arranging his estate did not reach one hundred taels—integrity and frugality were perhaps inborn.

units.zh: 朱士彥，字修承，江蘇寶應人。
units.en: Zhu Shiyan, whose courtesy name was Xiucheng, came from Baoying in Jiangsu.
units.literal: Zhu Shiyan, courtesy name Xiucheng, was a native of Baoying in Jiangsu.

units.zh: 父彬，績學通經，見儒林傳。
units.en: His father Bin was a distinguished classical scholar; see his biography in the Confucian Scholars section.
units.literal: His father Bin was a scholar of solid learning versed in the classics; see the Biographies of Confucian Scholars.

units.zh: 士彥承家學。
units.en: Shiyan inherited his family's scholarly tradition.
units.literal: Shiyan inherited the family learning.

units.zh: 成嘉慶七年一甲三名進士，授編修。
units.en: In 1802 he took the jinshi degree as third in the first class and was appointed a Hanlin compiler.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Jiaqing he became a jinshi of the third rank in the first class and was appointed Hanlin Compiler.

units.zh: 纂國史河渠志，諳習河事。
units.en: He compiled the river-control section of the National History and became thoroughly versed in hydraulic engineering.
units.literal: He compiled the River Control section of the National History and became thoroughly versed in river affairs.

units.zh: 大考擢贊善，督湖北學政。
units.en: After the grand examination he was promoted to tutor and appointed education commissioner for Hubei.
units.literal: In the grand examination he was promoted to Tutor and supervised education in Hubei.

units.zh: 累遷侍讀學士，入直上書房。
units.en: He rose to Attendant Reader and was assigned to the Upper Study.
units.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Attendant Reader and entered service in the Upper Study.

units.zh: 歷少詹事、內閣學士。
units.en: He served as Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent and as a Bachelor of the Grand Secretariat.
units.literal: He served successively as Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent and as a Bachelor of the Grand Secretariat.

units.zh: 道光二年，擢兵部侍郎。
units.en: In 1822 he was promoted to Vice Minister of War.
units.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was promoted to Vice Minister of War.

units.zh: 四年，以南河高堰壞，疏陳河工事宜，論：「高堰石工宜切實估修；
units.en: In 1824, after the Gaoyan dam on the Southern River failed, he memorialized on river works, arguing: "The stone works at Gaoyan must be honestly assessed and repaired;
units.literal: In the fourth year, because the Gaoyan dam on the Southern River was damaged, he submitted a memorial on river works affairs, arguing: "The stone works of Gaoyan dam should be genuinely estimated and repaired;

units.zh: 堰內二堤宜培補；
units.en: the two inner embankments should be reinforced;
units.literal: the two inner embankments of the dam should be reinforced;

units.zh: 黃河盛漲，宜兩岸分洩；
units.en: when the Yellow River floods heavily, both banks should be used for controlled discharge;
units.literal: when the Yellow River floods heavily, both banks should discharge in division;

units.zh: 山盱五壩宜相機開放；
units.en: the five Shanxu dams should be opened as circumstances require;
units.literal: the five dams of Shanxu should be opened as circumstances permit;

units.zh: 黃河下游無堤之處宜接築。」
units.en: unembanked sections of the lower Yellow River should receive connecting dikes."
units.literal: where the lower Yellow River has no dikes, dikes should be joined and built."

units.zh: 下勘河大臣文孚籌議酌行。
units.en: The memorial was referred to River Investigation Commissioner Wen Fu for deliberation and selective implementation.
units.literal: The memorial was sent down to River Investigation Commissioner Wen Fu to deliberate and implement as appropriate.

units.zh: 尋督浙江學政。
units.en: He was soon appointed education commissioner for Zhejiang.
units.literal: Soon afterward he supervised education in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 奏禁諸生包漕鬧漕，以端士習。
units.en: He memorialized to prohibit students from monopolizing and disrupting grain transport, to restore proper scholarly conduct.
units.literal: He memorialized prohibiting degree candidates from monopolizing grain transport and disrupting it, to rectify scholarly conduct.

units.zh: 御史錢儀吉劾士彥任性，詔嘉士彥能任勞怨；
units.en: Censor Qian Yiji impeached Shiyan for willfulness; the throne praised Shiyan for willingness to bear hardship and resentment;
units.literal: Censor Qian Yiji impeached Shiyan for willfulness; an edict praised Shiyan for being able to bear labor and resentment;

units.zh: 惟斥其父彬就養閱卷，及命題割裂，薄譴之。
units.en: but, regarding his father Bin grading papers while receiving support in his son's household, and regarding fragmented examination topics, Shiyan was only lightly reprimanded.
units.literal: only rebuking him concerning his father Bin receiving support and grading papers, and concerning fragmented examination topics, with a light reprimand.

units.zh: 九年，典會試，督安徽學政，尋擢左都御史，召還京。
units.en: In 1829 he presided over the metropolitan examination and supervised education in Anhui, was soon promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief, and recalled to the capital.
units.literal: In the ninth year he presided over the metropolitan examination, supervised education in Anhui, was soon promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief, and was recalled to the capital.

units.zh: 十一年，遷工部尚書。
units.en: In 1831 he was appointed Minister of Works.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Minister of Works.

units.zh: 是秋，江蘇大水，河、淮、湖同時漲溢，命偕尚書穆彰阿往勘。
units.en: That autumn catastrophic flooding struck Jiangsu as the Yellow River, Huai, and lakes overflowed together; he was ordered to investigate alongside Minister Mujang'a.
units.literal: That autumn Jiangsu suffered great flooding; the rivers, Huai, and lakes all rose and overflowed simultaneously; he was ordered to go with Minister Mujang'a to investigate.

units.zh: 穆彰阿先回京，遂偕左都御史白鎔察視江蘇、安徽水災賑務。
units.en: After Mujang'a returned to the capital, he accompanied Left Censor-in-Chief Bai Rong to oversee flood relief in Jiangsu and Anhui.
units.literal: Mujang'a returned to the capital first; he then accompanied Left Censor-in-Chief Bai Rong to inspect flood disaster relief in Jiangsu and Anhui.

units.zh: 疏言：揚河廳掣卸石工，及纖堤耳閘，應令工員賠修；
units.en: He memorialized that stone works torn away at the Yanghe Bureau and the slender embankment ear sluice should be repaired at engineering officers' expense;
units.literal: His memorial stated: the Yanghe Bureau's torn-away stone works and the slender embankment ear sluice should be ordered repaired at the expense of the engineering officers;

units.zh: 又以淮、揚地方官多調署，情形未熟，請飭江寧布政使林則徐、常鎮通海道張岳崧總司江北賑務，從之。
units.en: He also noted that Huai–Yang local officials were often acting appointees unfamiliar with conditions, and requested that Jiangning Administration Commissioner Lin Zexu and Circuit Intendant Zhang Yuesong oversee northern Jiangsu relief—the request was approved.
units.literal: he also noted that local officials in the Huai and Yang regions were often transferred on temporary assignment and unfamiliar with conditions, and requested that Jiangning Administration Commissioner Lin Zexu and Chang-Zhen-Tong-Hai Circuit Intendant Zhang Yuesong oversee northern Jiangsu relief affairs—the request was approved.

units.zh: 尋奏：「續查下河積潦之區，被災尤重，浮開戶口，為辦賑積弊。
units.en: He soon memorialized: "Further investigation of the lower-river flood zones found especially severe damage; inflating household registers is a longstanding abuse in relief administration.
units.literal: Soon he memorialized: "In further investigation of the lower-river areas with accumulated flooding, disaster was especially severe; inflating household registers is a longstanding abuse in relief work.

units.zh: 應令委員查明後，即於本鄉榜示，放賑時，州縣官據委員原查總發一榜，總查抽查，憑以核辦。」
units.en: Commissioners should investigate and post verified lists in each township; magistrates should distribute relief from a single consolidated register, with chief investigators conducting spot checks for verification."
units.literal: Commissioners should be ordered to investigate and then immediately post lists in the native township; when distributing relief, county and district magistrates should issue relief according to one consolidated list from the commissioners' original investigation, with chief investigators conducting spot checks for verification."

units.zh: 又奏：「山盱廳屬添建滾水石壩，本年啟放過水，現已無從查驗。
units.en: He also reported: "The newly built overflow stone dam in Shanxu jurisdiction was opened this year and can no longer be inspected while water remains high.
units.literal: He also memorialized: "The newly built overflow stone dam in Shanxu Bureau jurisdiction was opened to pass water this year and can no longer be inspected.

units.zh: 工員面稱啟放時石底間有衝裂，壩下灰土亦損，請俟水落責修完固。
units.en: Engineering officers reported cracks in the stone base and damage to the lime and earth below when the dam was opened; repairs should be required once water levels fall.
units.literal: The engineering officers stated in person that when opened the stone base had cracks in places and the lime and earth below the dam was also damaged; it is requested that after the water falls they be held responsible to repair it to completion and solidity.

units.zh: 堰、盱兩廳淮、湖石工掣卸二百餘丈，固限未滿，應令賠修。
units.en: At the Yan and Xu bureaus, over two hundred zhang of Huai and lake stone works were torn away before their warranty expired—engineering officers should repair them at their own expense.
units.literal: At the Yan and Xu bureaus, Huai and lake stone works torn away exceed two hundred zhang; the warranty period is not yet fulfilled—they should be ordered to repair at their own expense.

units.zh: 其石後磚工灰工間有殘缺，應令補築。
units.en: Brick and lime work behind the stone has gaps in places and should be repaired.
units.literal: Behind the stone, brick and lime works have gaps in places—they should be ordered supplemented and built.

units.zh: 又盱堰大堤，加幫土工間有蟄低浮松之處，應培補，責成河兵種柳護堤。
units.en: On the Xuyan great embankment, reinforced earthwork has sunk and loosened in places and should be rebuilt, with river soldiers assigned to plant willows for protection.
units.literal: Moreover, on the Xuyan great embankment, where additional earth was piled, there are places sunk low and loosely floating—they should be reinforced, with river soldiers charged to plant willows to protect the embankment.

units.zh: 其已估未辦之高堰頭、二兩堡，未估之智、信兩壩，應即興辦。
units.en: The Gaoyan first and second forts, already estimated but not started, and the Zhi and Xin dams, not yet estimated, should be undertaken immediately.
units.literal: The Gaoyan head and second forts already estimated but not yet undertaken, and the Zhi and Xin dams not yet estimated, should be immediately undertaken.

units.zh: 此項與黃河險要不同，向來保固一年。
units.en: Unlike critical Yellow River sections, these works have traditionally carried a one-year warranty.
units.literal: These items differ from critical Yellow River points; warranty has traditionally been one year.

units.zh: 請嗣後各廳土堤及運河堤岸，均改保固三年。
units.en: He requested that earthen embankments at all bureaus and Grand Canal banks hereafter carry a three-year warranty.
units.literal: It is requested that hereafter earthen embankments at all bureaus and Grand Canal banks uniformly have warranty changed to three years.

units.zh: 運河埽工於經歷一年後，再加保固二年，驗明堅整，始準埽汛修防。」
units.en: For canal revetment works, after one year an additional two-year warranty should apply; only after verification of sound construction should they enter routine flood-season maintenance."
units.literal: For Grand Canal revetment works, after one year has passed, add two more years of warranty; once verified solid and intact, only then permit revetment-flood-season repair and defense."

units.zh: 「安徽無為州江壩及銅陵縣壩工程緊要，均應藉款興修。」
units.en: The Jiang dam at Wuwei in Anhui and the Tongling County dam are critical projects and should both be funded and undertaken."
units.literal: The Jiang dam at Wuwei Prefecture in Anhui and the dam at Tongling County are critically important projects and should both be undertaken with borrowed funds."

units.zh: 並下所司議行。
units.en: The memorial was referred to the responsible offices for deliberation and implementation.
units.literal: The memorial was also sent down to the responsible offices for deliberation and implementation.

units.zh: 又劾鹽城、宿松、青陽等縣報災遲延遺漏，請懲處；
units.en: He also impeached Yancheng, Susong, Qingyang, and other counties for delayed and incomplete disaster reports, requesting punishment;
units.literal: He also impeached Yancheng, Susong, Qingyang, and other counties for delayed and incomplete disaster reporting, requesting punishment;

units.zh: 捐賑紳民應給議敘；
units.en: gentry who donated to relief efforts should receive honors;
units.literal: gentry and commoners who donated for relief should be given consideration for honors;

units.zh: 禁胥吏婪索挑剔：並從之。
units.en: and prohibiting clerks from extortion and petty harassment—all was approved.
units.literal: prohibiting clerks and runners from greedy extortion and nitpicking—all was approved.

units.zh: 十二年，事竣回京。
units.en: In 1832, when his mission was complete, he returned to the capital.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, when affairs were concluded, he returned to the capital.

units.zh: 南河於家灣奸民陳端等盜挖官堤，掣動河流，复偕穆彰阿往勘。
units.en: At Yujiawan on the Southern River, scoundrels led by Chen Duan illicitly dug the official embankment and diverted the current; he again accompanied Mujang'a to investigate.
units.literal: On the Southern River at Yujiawan, wicked commoners Chen Duan and others illicitly dug the official embankment, pulling the river current; he again accompanied Mujang'a to investigate.

units.zh: 疏言：「九月初旬，清口出水二尺有餘，高堰長水二丈一尺，勢至危險。
units.en: He memorialized: "In early September, Qingkou discharged over two chi of water and Gaoyan stood at two zhang one chi—the situation was extremely dangerous.
units.literal: His memorial stated: "In early ninth month, Qingkou discharged water of more than two chi; Gaoyan long water reached two zhang one chi—the situation was extremely dangerous.

units.zh: 其時吳城七堡未開，洪湖吃重。
units.en: At that time the seven Wucheng forts had not yet been opened, and Hong Lake bore the full pressure.
units.literal: At that time the seven forts of Wucheng were not yet opened, and Hong Lake bore the brunt.

units.zh: 此時既開放，湖水分減。
units.en: They have now been opened and lake levels have fallen.
units.literal: Now they have been opened and lake water has been reduced.

units.zh: 現交冬令，一月後即難興工，湖多積水，風烈堪虞，請加緊趕辦。」
units.en: Winter is approaching; within a month construction will become impossible; lakes still hold much water and fierce winds are a concern—urgent completion is requested."
units.literal: Winter is now at hand; after one month work will be difficult to undertake; the lakes hold much accumulated water and fierce winds are to be feared—urgent completion is requested."

units.zh: 尋命复偕侍郎敬徵往勘。
units.en: He was soon ordered to investigate again alongside Vice Minister Jingzheng.
units.literal: Soon he was again ordered to accompany Vice Minister Jingzheng to investigate.

units.zh: 十三年，奏於家灣正壩雖合龍，請飭加鑲追壓，以免出險。
units.en: In 1833 he reported that although the main Yujiawan dam had been closed, additional reinforcement and compaction should be ordered to prevent failure.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he memorialized that although the main dam at Yujiawan had been joined, additional inlaying and pressing should be ordered to prevent breach.

units.zh: 覆訊挖堤諸犯，治如律。
units.en: He re-examined the embankment-digging offenders and punished them according to law.
units.literal: He re-examined the offenders who dug the embankment and punished them according to law.

units.zh: 又偕敬徵覆勘河、湖各工，請分別緩急，以次辦理。
units.en: He again accompanied Jingzheng to re-inspect river and lake works, requesting that projects be prioritized and handled in sequence.
units.literal: He again accompanied Jingzheng in re-investigating river and lake works, requesting that urgency and delay be distinguished and matters handled in order.

units.zh: 父憂歸。
units.en: He returned home to observe mourning for his father.
units.literal: Upon his father's death he returned home for mourning.

units.zh: 十六年，服闋，署吏部尚書，偕尚書耆英赴廣東、江西鞫獄。
units.en: In 1836, after mourning ended, he served as acting Minister of Personnel and accompanied Minister Qiying to Guangdong and Jiangxi to adjudicate cases.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, when mourning was ended, he acted as Minister of Personnel and accompanied Minister Qiying to Guangdong and Jiangxi to try cases.

units.zh: 十七年，授兵部尚書。
units.en: In 1837 he was appointed Minister of War.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year he was appointed Minister of War.

units.zh: 查勘浙江海塘，遂赴南河驗料垛工程，盤查倉庫。
units.en: He inspected the Zhejiang seawall, then went to the Southern River to verify material-stockpile projects and audited warehouses.
units.literal: He inspected the Zhejiang seawall, then went to the Southern River to verify material-stockpile works and audited the warehouses.

units.zh: 以庫存與卷冊不符，劾河庫道李湘茝，褫職。
units.en: Finding warehouse stock did not match the records, he impeached River Warehouse Intendant Li Xiangzhi and stripped him of office.
units.literal: Because warehouse stock did not match the registers, he impeached River Warehouse Circuit Intendant Li Xiangzhi and stripped him of office.

units.zh: 又赴安徽、河南按事，疏陳常平倉糶買章程，「請各省囚糧遞糧作正開銷，毋動倉穀；
units.en: He also investigated affairs in Anhui and Henan and memorialized on Ever-Normal Granary regulations: "Each province should cover prisoner grain and relay transport from regular expenditures without drawing on Ever-Normal reserves;
units.literal: He also went to Anhui and Henan to investigate affairs and memorialized on Ever-Normal Granary sale and purchase regulations: "It is requested that in each province prisoner grain and relay grain be treated as regular expenditures and Ever-Normal grain not be touched;

units.zh: 平糶必市價在八錢以上始准出糶；
units.en: fair-price sales should be permitted only when market prices exceed eight qian;
units.literal: fair-price sale must wait until market price is above eight qian before sale is permitted;

units.zh: 採買須俟年豐穀賤，且必在出糶二三年後，以紓民力而袪宿弊」。
units.en: purchases should wait until years of abundance when grain is cheap, and should occur only two or three years after sales, to ease the people's burden and remove longstanding abuses."
units.literal: purchase must wait until years of abundance when grain is cheap, and must be two or three years after sale, to ease the people's strength and remove longstanding abuses."

units.zh: 如議行。
units.en: The proposals were adopted and implemented.
units.literal: As deliberated, it was implemented.

units.zh: 十八年，兼管順天府尹事，典會試。
units.en: In 1838 he concurrently managed the affairs of the Shuntian Prefect and presided over the metropolitan examination.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year he concurrently managed the affairs of the Shuntian Prefect and presided over the metropolitan examination.

units.zh: 調吏部尚書。
units.en: He was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 士彥以綜覈為宣宗所知，奉使按事皆稱旨。
units.en: Shiyan was known to the Daoguang Emperor for his thoroughness; on investigative missions he always met with imperial approval.
units.literal: Shiyan was known to the Xuanzong Emperor for his comprehensive scrutiny; on missions to investigate affairs he always met with imperial approval.

units.zh: 尋卒，詔嘉其性情直爽，辦事公正，贈太子太保，賜其四子舉人、副榜貢生有差，諡文定。
units.en: He died soon after; the throne praised his straightforward character and fair judgment; he was posthumously titled Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and his four sons received juren degrees and other honors; his posthumous name was Wending.
units.literal: Soon afterward he died; an edict praised his straightforward character and fair handling of affairs; he was given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and his four sons were granted juren, supplementary-list tribute students, and other honors in varying degrees; he was posthumously titled Wending.

units.zh: 何凌漢，字仙槎，湖南道州人。
units.en: He Linghan, whose courtesy name was Xiancha, came from Daozhou in Hunan.
units.literal: He Linghan, courtesy name Xiancha, was a native of Daozhou in Hunan.

units.zh: 拔貢，考授吏部七品小京官。
units.en: As a selected tribute student, he passed examination and was appointed a seventh-rank clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: As a selected tribute student, he passed examination and was appointed a seventh-rank junior Beijing clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 嘉慶十年一甲三名進士，授編修。
units.en: In 1805 he took the jinshi degree as third in the first class and was appointed a Hanlin compiler.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Jiaqing he became a jinshi of the third rank in the first class and was appointed Hanlin Compiler.

units.zh: 大考二等，擢司業。
units.en: After the grand examination he placed second class and was promoted to Vice Director of Studies.
units.literal: In the grand examination he placed second class and was promoted to Vice Director of Studies.

units.zh: 累遷右庶子。
units.en: He rose to Right Vice President of the Supervisorate of Education.
units.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Right Vice President of the Supervisorate of Education.

units.zh: 典廣東、福建鄉試，留福建學政。
units.en: He presided over the Guangdong and Fujian provincial examinations and remained as education commissioner in Fujian.
units.literal: He presided over the provincial examinations of Guangdong and Fujian and remained as education commissioner in Fujian.

units.zh: 令諸生自註誦習何經，據以考校，所取拔貢多樸學。
units.en: He required students to record which classic they studied and examined them accordingly; most of those he selected as tribute students were solid scholars of genuine learning.
units.literal: He ordered students to note for themselves which classic they recited and studied, and examined them accordingly; those he selected as tribute students were mostly solid scholars.

units.zh: 道光六年，授順天府尹。
units.en: In 1826 he was appointed Shuntian Prefect.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Daoguang he was appointed Shuntian Prefect.

units.zh: 京畿獄訟繁多，自立簿籍，每月按簿催結，無留獄。
units.en: With lawsuits flooding the capital region, he kept his own register and pressed monthly for closures, leaving no cases in detention.
units.literal: Prison lawsuits in the capital region were numerous; he established his own register and each month pressed for closure according to the register, with no cases left in detention.

units.zh: 遷大理寺卿，仍署府尹。
units.en: He was transferred to President of the Court of Judicial Review while continuing to act as Shuntian Prefect.
units.literal: He was transferred to President of the Court of Judicial Review while still acting as Prefect.

units.zh: 在任凡五年，歷左副都御史、工部侍郎。
units.en: Over five years in office he served as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Works.
units.literal: In office altogether five years, he served successively as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Works.

units.zh: 典浙江鄉試，留學政。
units.en: He presided over the Zhejiang provincial examination and remained as education commissioner.
units.literal: He presided over the Zhejiang provincial examination and remained as education commissioner.

units.zh: 命偕總督程祖洛按訊山陰、會稽紳幕書役句結舞弊，鞫實，請褫在籍按察使李澐職，餘犯軍流有差。
units.en: Ordered with Governor-General Cheng Zuluo to investigate collusion and fraud among gentry, secretaries, and clerks in Shanyin and Kuaiji, he established the facts, secured the dismissal of Provincial Judicial Commissioner Li Yun (then residing at home), and secured varying punishments for other offenders.
units.literal: He was ordered with Governor-General Cheng Zuluo to investigate collusion and fraud among gentry, secretaries, and clerks in Shanyin and Kuaiji; the facts were established, and he requested stripping Provincial Judicial Commissioner Li Yun, then residing at home, of office, with other offenders punished by military exile in varying degrees.

units.zh: 任未滿，調吏部侍郎，召回京，兼管順天府尹事。
units.en: Before his term ended he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel, recalled to the capital, and again placed in charge of Shuntian Prefect affairs.
units.literal: Before his term was complete he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel, recalled to the capital, and concurrently managed Shuntian Prefect affairs.

units.zh: 調戶部，復調吏部，仍兼署戶部侍郎。
units.en: He was transferred to Revenue, then back to Personnel, while still acting as Vice Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue, then back to the Ministry of Personnel, still concurrently acting as Vice Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 御史那斯洪阿條陳地方官有錢糧處分，不准升調，及變通雜稅，下部議。
units.en: Censor Nasihong'a proposed barring promotion for local officials with grain-tax penalties and reforming miscellaneous taxes; the matter was referred to the ministries.
units.literal: Censor Nasihong'a memorialized that local officials with grain-tax penalties should not be promoted or transferred, and that miscellaneous taxes should be reformed; the matter was sent to the ministries for deliberation.

units.zh: 凌漢兼吏、戶兩部，駁之，謂：「理煩治劇，每難其人，若格以因公處分，必至以中平無過者遷就升調。
units.en: Linghan, holding concurrent charge of Personnel and Revenue, rejected the proposal: "Managing difficult posts requires exceptional talent; barring officials with routine penalties would leave only mediocre, faultless candidates for promotion.
units.literal: Linghan held concurrent charge of the Ministries of Personnel and Revenue and rejected it, saying: "Managing complex and urgent affairs is always hard to find the right person for; if barred by penalties incurred in official business, one will end up promoting and transferring only mediocre men without fault.

units.zh: 且吏治與催科本非兩事，未有因循良而帑藏空虛者，亦未有因貪濁而倉庫充盈者，是在督撫為缺擇人，不為人擇缺，正不必徒事更張，轉滋窒礙。」
units.en: Moreover, good governance and tax collection are not separate: compliant officials do not leave treasuries empty, nor do corrupt ones fill storehouses. Governors should choose men for posts, not posts for men—empty reforms would only create obstruction."
units.literal: Moreover, good administration and tax collection are not two separate matters—there is none who is merely compliant yet leaves the treasury empty, nor none who is corrupt yet leaves storehouses full; the key is for governors to choose men for posts, not posts for men—there is no need for empty changes that only create obstruction."

units.zh: 又謂：「地方各稅，有落地雜稅，及房屋典當等稅，已極周密；
units.en: He also argued: "Local taxes, including transit duties and taxes on houses and pawnshops, are already comprehensive;
units.literal: He also said: "Local taxes, including transit miscellaneous taxes and taxes on houses and pawnshops, are already extremely thorough;

units.zh: 至京師九門外有鋪稅，天津、新疆沿壕鋪面有房租，因係官地、官房也。
units.en: shop taxes outside Beijing's Nine Gates and rents along trenches at Tianjin and Xinjiang apply only because the land and buildings are government property.
units.literal: as for shop taxes outside the Nine Gates of the capital and shop rents along the trenches at Tianjin and Xinjiang, these are because the land and buildings are government property.

units.zh: 今欲盡天下之府、廳、州、縣仿照定稅，則布帛菽粟民生日用所需，市儈將加價而取諸民以輸官，水腳火耗，官又將取之於民；
units.en: If every prefecture and county nationwide imposes such taxes, merchants will raise prices on daily necessities and pass costs to the people; officials will extract transport and conversion charges as well;
units.literal: if now every prefecture, department, and county in the empire is to imitate and fix taxes, then on cloth, silk, grain, and beans—the daily needs of the people—merchants will raise prices and take from the people to pay the government; transport and conversion charges, and officials will again take from the people;

units.zh: 且閉歇無常，稅額難定，有斂怨之名，無裕國之實。」
units.en: businesses open and close unpredictably, making tax rates impossible to fix—such a policy would breed resentment without enriching the state."
units.literal: moreover businesses open and close unpredictably, tax amounts are hard to fix—there is a name for collecting resentment but no reality of enriching the state."

units.zh: 前議遂寢。
units.en: The earlier proposal was shelved.
units.literal: The earlier proposal was then shelved.

units.zh: 十四年，擢左都御史，遷工部尚書，仍兼管府尹如故。
units.en: In 1834 he was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief and appointed Minister of Works while continuing to manage the Prefect's office.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief and transferred to Minister of Works, still managing the Prefect's office as before.

units.zh: 累署吏部尚書。
units.en: He repeatedly served as acting Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: He repeatedly acted as Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 十七年，吏部因京察一等人員有先由御史改官者議駁。
units.en: In 1837 the Ministry of Personnel rejected first-class capital-inspection candidates who had previously transferred from the censorate.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year the Ministry of Personnel rejected first-class personnel in the capital inspection who had previously been censors transferred to other posts.

units.zh: 凌漢以不勝御史，非不勝外任者比，如此苛繩，有妨言路。
units.en: Linghan argued that failure as a censor differs from failure in provincial service; such harsh restrictions would obstruct the remonstrance system.
units.literal: Linghan argued that failure as a censor is not comparable to failure in outside appointment; such harsh binding harms the avenue of remonstrance.

units.zh: 御史改部之員，例準截取。
units.en: Censors transferred to ministries are by precedent eligible for selection.
units.literal: Those who transferred from the censorate to ministries are by precedent permitted selection.

units.zh: 至京察雖無明文，從前有御史降調保送員外郎者，援以請旨。
units.en: Though capital inspection had no explicit rule, he cited precedent of demoted censors nominated as vice directors and requested an imperial ruling.
units.literal: As for capital inspection, though there is no explicit text, formerly there were censors demoted and transferred who were nominated as department directors—he cited this to request imperial decision.

units.zh: 因面奏現任大員花傑、吳榮光，皆曾由御史改降，遂奏俞允。
units.en: Citing in audience current high officials Hua Jie and Wu Rongguang, both demoted former censors, he secured imperial approval.
units.literal: He cited in audience the current high officials Hua Jie and Wu Rongguang, both of whom had been demoted after transferring from the censorate; the memorial was approved.

units.zh: 十九年，調戶部尚書。
units.en: In 1839 he was appointed Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year he was transferred to Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 四川總督寶興請按糧津貼防邊經費，議駁之，略謂：「川省地丁額徵六十六萬，田賦之輕，甲於天下。
units.en: When Sichuan Governor-General Bao Xing proposed a grain surcharge for frontier defense, Linghan rejected it: "Sichuan's land tax totals 660,000 taels—the lightest in the empire.
units.literal: Sichuan Governor-General Bao Xing requested a grain surcharge for frontier defense funds; he rejected it in deliberation, stating in summary: "Sichuan's land-poll and labor-service levy totals 660,000 taels; its land tax is the lightest in the empire.

units.zh: 現議按糧一兩加津貼二兩，百畝之家，不過出銀三兩，即得百萬兩，小民未必即苦輸將。
units.en: The proposal adds two taels per tael of tax; a hundred-mu household would pay only three taels, yielding one million taels—commoners might not feel immediate hardship.
units.literal: The present proposal adds two taels subsidy per tael of grain tax; a household of one hundred mu would pay no more than three taels of silver and one million taels would be obtained—the common people may not immediately suffer in paying.

units.zh: 然較原課幾增兩倍，非藏富於民之義，軍需藉資民力，尤不可率以為常。
units.en: Yet it nearly doubles the original levy—contrary to storing wealth among the people—and military funding drawn from popular strength must not become routine.
units.literal: Yet compared with the original levy it nearly doubles—not in the spirit of storing wealth among the people; military needs drawing on popular strength especially cannot be made routine.

units.zh: 請於各省秋撥項下借撥百萬兩，以三十萬為初設邊防經費，餘或發商，或置田，所獲息以四萬為常年經費，二萬提還借款，於防邊恤民兩有裨益。」
units.en: He proposed borrowing one million taels from provincial autumn disbursements: 300,000 for initial frontier defense, the rest lent or invested in land; annual interest of 40,000 would fund operations and 20,000 repay the loan—benefiting both frontier defense and the people."
units.literal: It is requested to borrow one million taels from each province's autumn disbursement items: 300,000 for initial frontier defense funds, the remainder lent to merchants or invested in land; interest obtained—40,000 for annual funds, 20,000 to repay the loan—benefits both frontier defense and care for the people."

units.zh: 詔允行。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: An edict approved implementation.

units.zh: 是年，典順天鄉試。
units.en: That year he presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.
units.literal: That year he presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.

units.zh: 子紹基亦典試福建，父子同持文柄，時人榮之。
units.en: His son Shaoji also presided over the Fujian examination; father and son holding examination authority together was celebrated at the time.
units.literal: His son Shaoji also presided over the examination in Fujian; father and son together held literary authority, and people of the time took it as an honor.

units.zh: 二十年，卒，贈太子太保，諡文安。
units.en: He died in 1840 and was posthumously titled Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the name Wen'an.
units.literal: In the twentieth year he died; he was given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and posthumously titled Wen'an.

units.zh: 紹基官編修，見文苑傳。
units.en: Shaoji served as a Hanlin compiler; see his biography in the Literary Men section.
units.literal: Shaoji served as Hanlin Compiler; see the Biographies of Literary Men.

units.zh: 李振祜，字錫名，安徽太湖人。
units.en: Li Zhenhu, whose courtesy name was Ximing, came from Taihu in Anhui.
units.literal: Li Zhenhu, courtesy name Ximing, was a native of Taihu in Anhui.

units.zh: 嘉慶六年進士，嘉慶六年進士，授內閣中書。
units.en: In the sixth year of Jiaqing, in 1801 he took the jinshi degree and was appointed an Inner Cabinet secretary.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Jiaqing, he became a jinshi in the sixth year of Jiaqing and was appointed Inner Cabinet Secretary.

units.zh: 典廣西、雲南鄉試，遷宗人府主事。
units.en: He presided over the Guangxi and Yunnan provincial examinations and was transferred to a secretary in the Imperial Clan Court.
units.literal: He presided over the provincial examinations of Guangxi and Yunnan and was transferred to a director in the Court of the Imperial Clan.

units.zh: 調兵部，遷員外郎，典陝甘鄉試，改御史、給事中。
units.en: He served in the Ministry of War, rose to vice director, presided over the Shaanxi-Gansu provincial examination, and was appointed censor and supervising secretary.
units.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of War, promoted to Department Director, presided over the Shaanxi-Gansu provincial examination, and was changed to Censor and Supervising Secretary.

units.zh: 巡視淮安漕務，劾戶部郎中錢學彬係不勝外任之員，違例截取知府，詔譴吏、戶二部堂官，予振祜議敘；
units.en: While inspecting Huai'an grain transport, he impeached Revenue Director Qian Xuebin as unfit for provincial service yet irregularly selected as prefect; the throne rebuked Personnel and Revenue ministers and honored Zhenhu;
units.literal: Inspecting Huai'an grain transport affairs, he impeached Revenue Department Director Qian Xuebin as unfit for outside appointment yet irregularly selected as prefect; an edict rebuked the chief officials of the Ministries of Personnel and Revenue and granted Zhenhu honors consideration;

units.zh: 又劾都察院京察給事中色成額先經列入六法，自赴公堂辯論，干求改列三等，反覆視若兒戲，都御史被嚴議，色成額仍列有疾。
units.en: He also impeached Supervising Secretary Se Cheng'e, first listed among the six methods of capital-inspection dismissal yet who argued in person to be changed to third class, treating the process as a game; the Censor-in-Chief was severely censured while Se Cheng'e was still listed as ill.
units.literal: He also impeached Censorate capital-inspection Supervising Secretary Se Cheng'e, who had first been listed among the six methods yet came in person to the public hall to argue, seeking to be changed to third class, treating the matter back and forth like child's play; the Censor-in-Chief was severely deliberated upon, yet Se Cheng'e was still listed as having illness.

units.zh: 累遷內閣侍讀學士，督山東學政。
units.en: He rose to Attendant Reader of the Inner Cabinet and was appointed education commissioner for Shandong.
units.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Attendant Reader of the Inner Cabinet and supervised education in Shandong.

units.zh: 應詔密陳山東積弊四事，略曰：「吏事叢脞，莫甚於官民不相安也。
units.en: By imperial command he confidentially memorialized four longstanding abuses in Shandong: "Official business is hopelessly tangled—nothing exceeds the estrangement between officials and people.
units.literal: In response to an edict he confidentially memorialized four accumulated abuses in Shandong, stating in summary: "Official affairs are tangled and complex—nothing exceeds the lack of peace between officials and people.

units.zh: 詞訟之繁，始由於官吏不辦，今又變而不敢辦。
