units.en: Lawsuits proliferated first because officials failed to act; now they dare not act at all.
units.literal: The proliferation of lawsuits at first stemmed from officials not handling cases; now it has changed to their not daring to handle them.

units.zh: 欲結一案，輒慮翻控；
units.en: Wishing to close a case, they fear counter-accusation;
units.literal: wishing to close a case, they constantly fear counter-accusation;

units.zh: 欲用一刑，輒慮反噬。
units.en: wishing to impose punishment, they fear retaliation.
units.literal: wishing to apply a punishment, they constantly fear retaliation.

units.zh: 鞫案之時，有倚老逞刁者，有恃婦女肆潑者，有當堂憤起者，有抗不畫供者，總由官吏恩信不結於平時，明決不著於臨事，以畏葸之才識，治刁悍之民風，殆於鑿枘不相入矣。
units.en: At trial some play on age, some deploy riotous women, some rage in court, some refuse to sign confessions—all because officials build no trust in ordinary times and show no decisiveness in crisis; timid officials governing a fierce populace is like forcing square pegs into round holes.
units.literal: When examining cases, some rely on age to act craftily, some rely on women to behave riotously, some rise in anger in court, some resist signing confessions—all because officials do not establish favor and trust in ordinary times and do not show clarity and decisiveness when matters arise; using timid talent and judgment to govern a crafty and fierce popular custom is like square and round pegs that cannot fit.

units.zh: 案牘壅滯，半由外府不辦事也。
units.en: Half the case backlog stems from prefectural governments failing to act.
units.literal: Backlogged documents are half due to outer prefectures not handling affairs.

units.zh: 各府州案件，動輒提省，委交首府，其中有不必提而輕提者，亦有各府州畏難而稟請提省者。
units.en: Prefectural cases are routinely transferred to the provincial capital and entrusted to the capital prefecture—some needlessly, others because prefectures fear difficulty and request transfer.
units.literal: Cases from each prefecture and department are constantly transferred to the province and entrusted to the capital prefecture; among them are those unnecessarily and lightly transferred, and also those where each prefecture and department, fearing difficulty, memorializes requesting provincial transfer.

units.zh: 濟南府統轄十六州縣，自治不暇，而舍己耘人，勢必兩廢。
units.en: Jinan Prefecture governs sixteen counties yet cannot manage its own affairs while taking on others'—both must fail.
units.literal: Jinan Prefecture governs sixteen counties and districts and has no leisure for its own administration, yet abandons its own fields to cultivate others'—both are bound to fail.

units.zh: 各府州畏難之事，輒以一稟提省卸責，轉得遂其取巧偷安之計。
units.en: Prefectures transfer difficult cases to the province with a single memorial to shed responsibility, achieving their scheme of shortcuts and ease.
units.literal: Matters each prefecture and department fear are handled by one memorial transferring to the province to shed responsibility, thereby achieving their scheme of taking shortcuts and seeking ease.

units.zh: 且疑難案件，本地聞見較真，遠提至省，則茫無頭緒，必致訟師盤踞省城，遇事挑唆，一事株連數十人，一案壓擱一二載，是欲辦案而轉以延案，欲弭訟而適以滋訟矣。
units.en: Difficult cases are better understood locally; transferred to the provincial capital, investigators lack context, litigation masters flock to the city, one case implicates dozens and stalls for years—intending to resolve cases while prolonging them, intending to reduce lawsuits while multiplying them.
units.literal: Moreover, in difficult cases local knowledge is more reliable; transferred far to the province, there is no clue where to begin, inevitably causing litigation masters to occupy the provincial capital, stirring up trouble at every turn, one matter implicating dozens, one case delayed one or two years—wishing to handle cases yet prolonging them, wishing to end lawsuits yet increasing them.

units.zh: 緝捕無策，則盜賊充斥也。
units.en: Without effective arrest policy, bandits fill the land.
units.literal: With no strategy for arrest, bandits fill the land.

units.zh: 東省盜賊，結黨剽掠，處處有之。
units.en: Shandong bandits form gangs and plunder everywhere.
units.literal: In the eastern province bandits form gangs and plunder—everywhere there are such.

units.zh: 護贓行強，雖小竊而情同大盜；
units.en: They protect stolen goods and act with force—even petty theft equals major robbery;
units.literal: protecting stolen goods and acting with force, though petty theft the circumstances equal great robbery;

units.zh: 分肥藐法，雖士類亦甘作窩家。
units.en: sharing spoils and defying the law, even gentry serve as fences.
units.literal: sharing spoils and despising the law, even gentry willingly serve as receivers.

units.zh: 劫去馬牛，定價勒贖，明目張膽，毫不畏官。
units.en: They seize livestock, fix ransom prices, and act openly without fear of officials.
units.literal: Seizing horses and cattle, fixing prices and extorting ransom, openly and boldly, utterly unafraid of officials.

units.zh: 總緣捕役悉與勾連，平日分贓，臨時送信。
units.en: This stems from constables' collusion—sharing spoils daily and warning bandits when arrests are attempted.
units.literal: All because constables and runners are entirely in collusion, sharing spoils in ordinary times and sending warnings when action is taken.

units.zh: 甚至失事者以訴懇官捕為累，以備價私贖為便。
units.en: Victims even regard official prosecution as a burden and private ransom as preferable.
units.literal: Victims even regard appealing for official arrest as a burden and paying ransom privately as convenient.

units.zh: 州縣既吝養捕之資，又不講練捕之法；
units.en: Magistrates stint on constables' pay and neglect their training;
units.literal: Counties and districts are both stingy with funds for maintaining constables and do not teach methods of training them;

units.zh: 既無獲盜之賞，又不嚴通盜之誅。
units.en: they offer no rewards for captures and punish collusion lightly.
units.literal: there are neither rewards for capturing bandits nor strict punishment for harboring them.

units.zh: 兼以自顧處分，動思諱飾，化大為小，咸所不免。
units.en: Fearing penalties, officials constantly conceal crimes, downgrading serious cases—all inevitable.
units.literal: Added to this, fearing penalties for themselves, officials constantly think to conceal, turning great into small—all cannot be avoided.

units.zh: 緝捕之弊如此。
units.en: Such are the abuses in law enforcement.
units.literal: Such are the abuses in arrest and pursuit.

units.zh: 錢糧不清，則虧空難杜也。
units.en: When tax accounts are unclear, deficits cannot be prevented.
units.literal: When grain taxes are unclear, deficits are hard to stop.

units.zh: 東省州縣正雜錢糧，新舊挪掩，習為故常。
units.en: In Shandong, magistrates routinely shift and cover regular and miscellaneous tax accounts between old and new.
units.literal: In the eastern province counties and districts' regular and miscellaneous grain taxes are shifted and covered between old and new—a practice habitual.

units.zh: 其弊由於交代不清，自三四任以至十餘任，轇葛不清者，比比皆是。
units.en: The abuse stems from unclear handovers—accounts tangled across three to ten successive magistrates are everywhere.
units.literal: The abuse stems from unclear handovers—from three or four terms to more than ten, tangled and unclear cases are everywhere.

units.zh: 官虧而外，更有書虧。
units.en: Beyond official deficits are clerks' deficits.
units.literal: Beyond official deficits there are also clerks' deficits.

units.zh: 查書虧情弊，或串通幕丁，朦混本官；
units.en: Clerks' deficits involve collusion with secretaries to deceive magistrates;
units.literal: Investigating clerks' deficit abuses, some collude with secretaries and runners to deceive their superior;

units.zh: 私雕假印，偽造串票。
units.en: forging seals and receipts.
units.literal: privately carving false seals and forging linked receipts.

units.zh: 有滿其私橐而遠颺者，有挾制本官而自供不諱者。
units.en: Some fill their purses and flee; others coerce magistrates and confess openly.
units.literal: Some fill their private purses and flee far away; some coerce their superior and confess without reserve.

units.zh: 州縣迴護，處分隱忍代認，而奸書遂益以侵蝕為得計。
units.en: Magistrates shield them, accepting penalties on their behalf, so wicked clerks increasingly treat embezzlement as sound policy.
units.literal: Counties and districts shield them, penalties are endured and acknowledged on their behalf, and wicked clerks thus increasingly take encroachment as their strategy.

units.zh: 錢糧之弊如此。」
units.en: Such are the abuses in tax collection."
units.literal: Such are the abuses in grain taxes."

units.zh: 疏入，上嘉納之。
units.en: The memorial was well received by the throne.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted, the Emperor praised and accepted it.

units.zh: 又劾泰安知府延璐、東昌知府熊方受請，飭交撫臣查察嚴參；
units.en: He also impeached Tai'an Prefect Yan Lu and Dongchang Prefect Xiong Fangshou, requesting they be referred to the governor for investigation and severe impeachment;
units.literal: He also impeached Tai'an Prefect Yan Lu and Dongchang Prefect Xiong Fangshou, requesting they be referred to the governor for investigation and severe impeachment;

units.zh: 又劾東昌知府王果陵辱生員，褫王果職；
units.en: he also impeached Dongchang Prefect Wang Guo for insulting a student and stripped him of office;
units.literal: he also impeached Dongchang Prefect Wang Guo for insulting a degree candidate and stripped Wang Guo of office;

units.zh: 又察出假印試卷、勾結舞弊之人，奏請懲辦。
units.en: he uncovered forged examination papers and examination fraud and memorialized for punishment.
units.literal: he also uncovered examination papers with false seals and persons colluding in fraud, memorializing to request punishment.

units.zh: 道光二年，遷太僕寺少卿。
units.en: In 1822 he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
units.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

units.zh: 父憂去官，服闋，補順天府丞。
units.en: He left office upon his father's death; after mourning, he was appointed deputy intendant of Shuntian Prefecture.
units.literal: Upon his father's death he left office; after mourning was completed, he was appointed Deputy Intendant of Shuntian Prefecture.

units.zh: 歷通政司副使、光祿寺卿、太常寺卿、宗人府丞。
units.en: He served successively as vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission, minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and director of the Imperial Clan Court.
units.literal: He served successively as Vice Commissioner of the Office of Transmission, Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan.

units.zh: 十五年，署順天府尹。
units.en: In Daoguang 15 he served as acting intendant of Shuntian Prefecture.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year he acted as Intendant of Shuntian Prefecture.

units.zh: 累遷內閣學士。
units.en: He rose to Academician of the Inner Cabinet.
units.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Academician of the Inner Cabinet.

units.zh: 十八年，授工部侍郎，調吏部，兼署倉場侍郎。
units.en: In Daoguang 18 he was appointed Vice Minister of Works, transferred to Personnel, and concurrently acted as Vice Minister of the Granary.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed Vice Minister of Works, transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, and concurrently acted as Vice Minister of the Granary.

units.zh: 二十一年，擢刑部尚書。
units.en: In Daoguang 21 he was promoted to Minister of Justice.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year he was promoted to Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 浙江提督余步雲海疆僨事，逮問治罪。
units.en: When Zhejiang Provincial Commander Yu Buyun bungled coastal defense, he was arrested, interrogated, and punished.
units.literal: Zhejiang Provincial Military Commissioner Yu Buyun failed in coastal affairs; he was arrested, interrogated, and punished.

units.zh: 廷臣猶有為議輕比者，振祜堅持，得伸法。
units.en: Though court ministers still argued for leniency, Zhenhu held firm and saw the law enforced.
units.literal: Court ministers still argued for a lighter comparison of punishment; Zhenhu held firm and the law was fully enforced.

units.zh: 二十八年元旦，加恩年老諸臣，加太子太保。
units.en: At the New Year's audience of Daoguang 28, honored among elderly ministers, he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: On New Year's Day of the twenty-eighth year, in granting favor to elderly ministers, he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 二十九年，因病乞休，許之。
units.en: In Daoguang 29 he requested retirement due to illness and was granted leave.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, ill, he requested retirement and was granted it.

units.zh: 三十年，卒，年七十四，諡莊肅。
units.en: He died in Daoguang 30 at seventy-four and received the posthumous name Zhuangsu.
units.literal: In the thirtieth year he died at seventy-four and was posthumously titled Zhuangsu.

units.zh: 宗室恩桂，字小山，隸鑲藍旗。
units.en: Engui of the Imperial Clan, whose courtesy name was Xiaoshan, belonged to the Bordered Blue Banner.
units.literal: Imperial clansman Engui, courtesy name Xiaoshan, was of the Bordered Blue Banner.

units.zh: 道光二年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: In 1822 he took the jinshi degree, entered the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed a Hanlin compiler.
units.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he became a jinshi, was selected as a Hanlin Bachelor, and was appointed Hanlin Compiler.

units.zh: 九遷至內閣學士，兼副都統。
units.en: Through nine promotions he reached Academician of the Inner Cabinet, concurrently Vice Commander-in-Chief.
units.literal: Through nine promotions he reached Academician of the Inner Cabinet, concurrently serving as Vice Commander-in-Chief.

units.zh: 十五年，授盛京工部侍郎，尋召為兵部侍郎，調吏部。
units.en: In 1835 he was appointed Vice Minister of Works at Mukden, soon recalled as Vice Minister of War, then transferred to Personnel.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Vice Minister of Works at Mukden, soon recalled as Vice Minister of War, then transferred to Personnel.

units.zh: 因曠文職六班，降內閣學士。
units.en: Absent from six civil office sessions, he was demoted to Academician of the Inner Cabinet.
units.literal: Because he was absent from six sessions of civil office, he was demoted to Academician of the Inner Cabinet.

units.zh: 歷工部、吏部侍郎，管理國子監事，兼護軍統領、左右翼總兵。
units.en: He served as Vice Minister of Works and Personnel, managed the Imperial Academy, and concurrently commanded the Guard and the Left and Right Wings.
units.literal: He served successively as Vice Minister of Works and Personnel, managed Imperial Academy affairs, and concurrently was Commander of the Guard, and Commander-in-Chief of the Left and Right Wings.

units.zh: 十九年，典順天鄉試，偕大理寺卿何汝霖往浙江按學政李國杞被劾事，遂查勘南河、東河料垛，奏劾虛缺浮用者，議譴有差。
units.en: In 1839 he presided over the Shuntian examination and accompanied Court President He Rulin to Zhejiang to investigate Education Commissioner Li Guoqi; he then inspected Southern and Eastern River material stockpiles, impeaching those with false shortages and excessive spending, with varying punishments.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year he presided over the Shuntian provincial examination and accompanied President of the Court of Judicial Review He Rulin to Zhejiang to investigate the impeached Education Commissioner Li Guoqi; he then inspected material stockpiles on the Southern and Eastern rivers, memorializing to impeach those with false shortages and excessive use, with varying degrees of censure deliberated.

units.zh: 二十年，充內務府大臣，管理上駟院。
units.en: In 1840 he served as Minister of the Imperial Household and managed the Imperial Stud.
units.literal: In the twentieth year he served as Minister of the Imperial Household and managed the Imperial Stud.

units.zh: 議增圓明園丁四百名，命偕尚書賽尚阿督率訓練。
units.en: It was proposed to add four hundred Old Summer Palace garden workmen, and he was ordered with Minister Saishanga to train them.
units.literal: It was proposed to add four hundred gardeners for the Old Summer Palace; he was ordered with Minister Saishanga to supervise and train them.

units.zh: 二十一年，授理籓院尚書，兼署左都御史。
units.en: In 1841 he was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and acting Left Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and concurrently acted as Left Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 劾太常寺丞豐伸及查倉御史廣祜不職，並罷之。
units.en: He impeached Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Feng Shen and the granary-inspection Censor Guang Hu for dereliction of duty, and both were dismissed.
units.literal: He impeached Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Feng Shen and granary-inspection Censor Guang Hu for dereliction of duty and dismissed both.

units.zh: 署步軍統領。
units.en: He served as acting Commander of the Foot Soldiers.
units.literal: He acted as Commander of the Foot Soldiers.

units.zh: 奏言：「京城巡捕五營槍兵一千名，不足以資捍衛，增設一千。
units.en: He memorialized: "The capital's five patrol battalions have only one thousand musket troops, insufficient for defense—add one thousand.
units.literal: He memorialized: "The capital's five patrol battalions have one thousand musket soldiers, insufficient for defense—add one thousand.

units.zh: 裁撤藤牌弓箭等兵，改為槍兵；
units.en: Replace rattan-shield archers with musket troops;
units.literal: Abolish rattan-shield archers and similar troops and change them to musket soldiers;

units.zh: 不敷者，於各營兵丁內揀選足額。
units.en: fill shortfalls by selecting from other battalions.
units.literal: where insufficient, select from soldiers in each battalion to fill the quota.

units.zh: 輪派二百名打靶，操演陣式。」
units.en: Rotate two hundred men for target practice and formation drills."
units.literal: Rotate two hundred for target practice and drill in formation."

units.zh: 詔議行。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: An edict ordered deliberation and implementation.

units.zh: 二十二年，調禮部尚書，又調吏部，實授步軍統領。
units.en: In 1842 he was transferred to Minister of Rites, then Personnel, and formally appointed Commander of the Foot Soldiers.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Minister of Rites, then to Personnel, and formally appointed Commander of the Foot Soldiers.

units.zh: 上御閱武樓，親閱圓明園兵丁槍操，步式整齊，施放有準，嘉恩桂督率有方，賜花翎。
units.en: The Emperor reviewed Old Summer Palace musket drills from the Military Review Tower; troops marched in perfect order and fired accurately—Engui received peacock feathers for effective command.
units.literal: The Emperor ascended the Military Review Tower and personally reviewed the Old Summer Palace soldiers' musket drill; their steps were orderly and firing accurate—Engui's supervision was praised as effective and peacock feathers were bestowed.

units.zh: 時議節冗費，恩桂先已奏裁上駟院馬六百餘匹。
units.en: As economy measures were debated, Engui had already memorialized to cut over six hundred Imperial Stud horses.
units.literal: At the time economy of redundant expenses was discussed; Engui had already memorialized to cut more than six hundred horses from the Imperial Stud.

units.zh: 又奏言南苑六圈，請裁其二，並裁各圈及京圈馬二百餘匹。
units.en: He also proposed cutting two of the Southern Park's six enclosures and over two hundred horses from park and capital herds.
units.literal: He also memorialized that of the six enclosures of the Southern Park, two should be cut, and more than two hundred horses from each enclosure and the capital enclosures cut as well.

units.zh: 上駟院、司鞍、司轡、蒙古醫生舊支馬乾銀，均減半給，如議行。
units.en: Horse-forage payments to the Imperial Stud, Saddle Office, Harness Office, and Mongol physicians were halved as proposed.
units.literal: The Imperial Stud, Saddle Office, Harness Office, and Mongol physicians' former horse-forage silver payments were all halved, as deliberated and implemented.

units.zh: 以兼攝事繁，罷管內務府，二十五年，復之。
units.en: Relieved of Imperial Household duties due to overload, he resumed them in 1845.
units.literal: Because concurrent duties were numerous, he was relieved of managing the Imperial Household; in the twenty-fifth year he resumed it.

units.zh: 恩桂在吏部，嚴杜冒濫。
units.en: At Personnel, Engui strictly blocked fraudulent appointments.
units.literal: At the Ministry of Personnel, Engui strictly blocked fraudulent appointments.

units.zh: 兼步軍統領衙門最久，先後逾十年，綜覈整頓，釐定章程，訓練兵卒，皆有實效，宣宗甚倚之。
units.en: He commanded the Foot Soldiers for over ten years—the longest tenure—reorganizing regulations and training troops with real effect; the Daoguang Emperor relied on him heavily.
units.literal: He held concurrent charge of the Foot Soldiers command longest, altogether more than ten years; comprehensive scrutiny and reorganization, fixing regulations, training soldiers—all had real effect, and the Xuanzong Emperor relied on him greatly.

units.zh: 二十六年，京察，特予議敘。
units.en: In 1846, capital inspection specially granted him honors.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, in capital inspection, he was specially granted honors consideration.

units.zh: 又幸南苑，見草木牲畜蕃盛，嘉恩桂經理得宜，加一秩。
units.en: Visiting the Southern Park again and seeing flourishing plants and livestock, the Emperor praised Engui's management and added one rank.
units.literal: The Emperor again visited the Southern Park and saw plants and livestock flourishing; praising Engui's proper management, he added one rank.

units.zh: 迭奉命治倉胥舞弊，及戶部捐納房書吏賄充司員、收受陋規諸獄，並持正不撓法。
units.en: Repeatedly ordered to prosecute granary clerks' fraud and Revenue Ministry donation-office bribery and improper fees, he upheld the law without compromise.
units.literal: Repeatedly by imperial command he handled granary clerks' fraud, and cases of Revenue Ministry donation-office clerks bribing to fill department posts and receiving improper fees—and throughout upheld the law without bending.

units.zh: 二十八年，卒於官，上深悼惜，稱其任勞任怨，殫竭血誠，贈太保，賜金治喪，諡文肅。
units.en: He died in office in 1848; the Emperor deeply mourned him, praising his willingness to bear hardship and resentment and his wholehearted dedication; he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian, given gold for the funeral, and posthumously titled Wensu.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he died in office; the Emperor deeply mourned and lamented, praising his bearing labor and resentment and exhausting his loyal blood; he was given Grand Preceptor, gold for funeral arrangements, and posthumously titled Wensu.

units.zh: 論曰：姚文田建言切中時弊，戴敦元清介幹事，其風概越流俗矣。
units.en: The commentators observe: Yao Wentian's memorials struck at contemporary abuses; Dai Dunyuan was incorruptible and capable—their character rose above the common run.
units.literal: Commentary says: Yao Wentian's memorials struck at the abuses of the age; Dai Dunyuan was pure, upright, and capable in affairs—their bearing surpassed the vulgar current.

units.zh: 朱士彥之治河，何凌漢之掌計，李振祜之執法，並號稱職。
units.en: Zhu Shiyan's river management, He Linghan's fiscal stewardship, and Li Zhenhu's law enforcement were all acclaimed as dutiful service.
units.literal: Zhu Shiyan's management of rivers, He Linghan's charge of accounts, and Li Zhenhu's enforcement of law were all acclaimed as fulfilling duty.

units.zh: 恩桂奏績金吾，肅清輦轂，一時稱矯矯焉。
units.en: Engui distinguished himself commanding the capital guard and securing the imperial precincts—at the time he was hailed as outstanding among his peers.
units.literal: Engui reported achievements as commander of the capital guard, purifying the imperial precincts—for a time he was called outstanding.
